title: DOW-UAP-D4, Mission Report, Arabian Gulf, 2020
doc_notes: This document is a redacted Department of War Mission Report (MISREP) regarding a UAP sighting in the Arabian Gulf, with most pages heavily redacted under 1.4(a).

incidents.summary: A U.S. military pilot observed a UAP traveling at 321 knots that increased speed and changed direction to the east.
incidents.quote: UAP INCREASED SPEED AND CHANGED DIRECTION TOWARDS THE EAST.
